name: Keycloak 26 Identity and SSO Server
description: Single sign-on, OAuth2/OIDC and SAML for your apps, backed by Postgres.

PORT.description: Port Keycloak's HTTP listener uses; Railway routes the public domain and its healthcheck here.

KEYCLOAK_VERSION.description: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak tag the image is built from (build argument). Change it to upgrade; back up Postgres first.

KC_HOSTNAME.description: Public base URL used in tokens (issuer) and redirects. Change it when you add a custom domain.

KC_HOSTNAME_BACKCHANNEL_DYNAMIC.description: Lets apps in this project call Keycloak over the private network (http://keycloak.railway.internal:8080) for token, JWKS and introspection requests.

KC_PROXY_HEADERS.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers from Railway's edge proxy, which terminates TLS.

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Plain HTTP listener behind Railway's TLS-terminating edge.

KC_HTTP_PORT.description: HTTP port, kept equal to PORT.

KC_HTTP_HOST.description: Bind address. :: is dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6), so private-network callers reach Keycloak in every Railway environment.

KC_DB.description: Database vendor. Build-time option, baked into the optimized image; keep it postgres.

KC_DB_URL_HOST.description: Postgres host on the private network.

KC_DB_PASSWORD.description: Postgres password (generated on the Postgres service).

KC_DB_POOL_MAX_SIZE.description: Maximum database connections per Keycloak replica (upstream default 100; Postgres allows 100 in total).

KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username of the temporary admin created in the master realm on first start. Changing it later has no effect.

KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of that temporary admin (generated). Sign in with it, create a permanent admin, then delete the temporary one.

KC_CACHE.description: local = single-node caches (one replica). Set ispn before raising replicas so nodes form a JGroups cluster via the database (jdbc-ping).

KC_LOG_LEVEL.description: Root log level (e.g. info, debug, or info,org.keycloak.events:debug).

JVM_HEAP_MAX_MB.description: Upper bound for the JVM heap in MB. The entrypoint uses the smaller of this, 70% of the container memory limit, and the limit minus 384 MB.

JVM_HEAP_PERCENT.description: Share of the container memory limit the heap may use (Keycloak's own default ratio), capped by JVM_HEAP_MAX_MB.

JVM_MAX_CPUS.description: CPU count reported to the JVM (sizes GC and HTTP thread pools). Lowered automatically if the container has a smaller CPU quota.

DB_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long the entrypoint waits for Postgres to accept connections before starting Keycloak (0 = do not wait).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time between SIGTERM and SIGKILL on redeploys so Keycloak can shut down cleanly.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down.
